newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Facilities initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - U.S. Facilities initiated.

text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said on Thursday it initiated coverage of U.S. Facilities Corp, a medical stop-loss insurance company, with a near-term rating of market perform and a long-term outperform rating.
-- U.S. Facilities sells for eight times Everen's 1997 operating income estimate of $2.43 a share and 7.3 times the 1998 estimate of $2.68.
-- "We believe that the low valuations offer downside protection in the stock," Everen said. "Nevertheless, we do not anticipate significant multiple expansion until industry conditions improve."
